name: daily-standup
description: Joshua's daily driver — recall context, scan work, plan the day, capture learnings

steps.name: Recall yesterday
steps.description: Search ruflo memory (namespace 'daily') for the last 3 days of entries. Summarize what was in flight, what got finished, and what was left blocked.

steps.name: Scan active work
steps.description: For each tracked project, report git branch, uncommitted changes, commits in the last 24h, and any failing checks. Flag stale branches (no commits in 7+ days) and anything left uncommitted overnight.

steps.name: Plan today
steps.description: Produce a ranked plan of at most 5 items for today. Carry over blocked items from recall, add work implied by scan. Each item gets an explicit 'done when' line. Call out the single highest-leverage task.

steps.name: Capture to memory
steps.description: Write today's plan to ruflo memory under namespace 'daily' with key 'YYYY-MM-DD', and append it to journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md.
